# SuccessFactors fixtures

These reduced HTML fixtures model the public SuccessFactors Recruiting Marketing
pages used by the SAP India careers category. They retain only the listing,
pagination, structured detail, empty-state, malformed-response, and access-block
shapes needed by adapter tests. `detail_filled.html` is the empty shell SAP serves
for a closed requisition that its listing still advertises. They contain no applicant or session data.
